metadata.title: Claude Doesn't Drop In a Chat Widget — It Wires the SDK.
metadata.purpose: Answer one real question in the Plain register: does 'Contact Center, web' mean Claude drops in a ready-made chat widget, or does it wire the Zoom Web SDK's events into your own site? Lands the carry-out that contact-center/web makes Claude wire chat, video, and campaign embeds through events, context, and postMessage — not hand over a finished widget.

beats.narration_text: A skill is a folder Claude reads before it works. This one is contact-center, web. Inside are six items: a RUNBOOK and a SKILL file, plus folders for concepts, examples, references, and troubleshooting. Claude reads the file, then follows it.

beats.narration_text: contact-center/web is a specification written as an instruction set. Its job: the Zoom Contact Center Web SDK — chat, video, and campaign embeds, engagement event handling, app-context integrations, and Smart Embed postMessage workflows. Follow it, and the result repeats: same input, same output, every run. Ask for anything outside that list, and there's no mode that covers it.

shot.new_visual_element: Four scope-item cards: chat/video/campaign embeds, engagement events, app-context integrations, Smart Embed postMessage; a boundary line with 'nothing outside this list' beyond it

production_viz.mechanic: Four rows fill in one at a time with a checkmark: 'Chat / video / campaign embeds', 'Engagement event handling', 'App-context integrations', 'Smart Embed postMessage'. A dashed boundary line beneath the list, with a faint unlabelled field beyond it captioned 'nothing outside this list'.

beats.narration_text: Contact Center, web doesn't hand you a drop-in chat widget — it wires the Zoom Web SDK's chat, video, and campaign embeds into your own site through events, context, and postMessage, the same way every time.
